findings.evidence: V1.3.4 restored exact flattened simulator state, then fresh policy RGB diverged at probe 53/T3.

LIBERO set_init_state calls sim.set_state_from_flattened, sim.forward, _post_process and forced observable update; it does not restore wrapper counters, controller state, RNG state or renderer history.
OSC goals/interpolators and robot recent buffers are mutable Python objects; fresh environment construction initializes them independently.
Observable sampling time, delay, sampled flag, cache and current value are mutable and can affect regenerated observations.
V1.3.4 calls env.seed(0) but has no exact Python/NumPy/Torch RNG-state receipt; V1.4 must capture or prove no primary-window draw.

The pinned clean runner captures actual model inputs through _stage_v_last_model_inputs, but V1.3.4 branch logic re-renders and calls policy again. V1.4 sidecars now provide exact loaded bytes, pending runtime wiring.
The pinned path is eval-mode, deterministic generation, one call per step, and restores its temporary generate hook. A machine-readable stateless receipt is still required before authorization.
Fresh-render hashes remain descriptive; any primary action/treatment/label consuming them is a protocol violation and hard stop.
Primary M3.5/M4 uses canonical clean reference actions and changes only registered gripper OPEN; native closed-loop is secondary after V_phys freezes.

decision: No V1.4 runtime authorization yet. Complete runtime snapshot capture/restore or exact reconstruction, then independent audit; Gate A must be zero-treatment and may not reuse the sealed V1.3.4 root.
